The '''''Wayfarer's Guide to Thrantas''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] found on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] which served as a guide for the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Thranta/Legends|Thrantas]].<ref name="Stronghold" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Wayfarer's Guide to Thrantas'' is seen in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'' in the Alderaan Stronghold.<ref name="Stronghold" />
